name: Whot!
summary: Fast shedding card game where you match symbols or numbers to empty your hand, similar to Uno and Crazy Eights.
rules_text: Use a 54-card Whot deck with 5 suits (circle, cross, triangle, star, square) numbered 1-14 unevenly plus 5 Whot-20 wild cards. Deal 6 cards each (3-6 in Nigerian variant), place one face up as call card and rest face down as market. On your turn play a card matching call card's shape or number, or play a Whot wild to choose the required shape, or draw the top market card. Special cards: 2 forces next player to draw 2 unless they stack another 2, 5 forces draw 3 unless stacked with 5, 8 skips next player, 1 holds all and you play again, 14 makes all other players draw 1 and you play again, Whot wild changes shape. Stacked draws accumulate. Must announce Last card and Check up when finishing or draw 2 penalty. First to shed all cards wins round; multi-round can be scored by remaining card values.
rating_reason: Strategic shedding game like Uno, hidden hands suits
